ai_summary: MahaDBT is Maharashtra's portal for state scholarships and DBT benefits to students and citizens.
ai_explanation: MahaDBT consolidates Maharashtra government scholarships (post-matric for SC/ST/OBC/Minority/EBC etc.) and other DBT schemes. Students register, upload certificates, and receive funds directly to their bank after verification.
